usage: 櫃 (gwai6) is a noun meaning 'cabinet' used to describe a piece of furniture for storage.
櫃 can be used with measure words like 個 (go3) or 座 (zo6) when counting specific items.
It can appear in compound words like 書櫃 (syu1 gwai6) meaning book cabinet.
櫃 is mostly used for indoor furniture to keep things organized.
When describing a location or action, 櫃 can be combined with verbs, for example, 開櫃 (hoi1 gwai6) means to open the cabinet.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 gwai6.
gwai6 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 syu1.
examples.meaning: There are many books inside the cabinet.
